concerns.text: Task T001a is marked as 'FAILED' and 'REJECTED' in the analyze report, yet it is the only task explicitly assigned to update spec.md to align with the Plan's deviation (OQMD source). Without a successful task to update the spec, FR-001 remains contradictory to the implementation plan, leaving the spec unaligned with the executed code.

Tasks T006a (Split & Binning) and T006b (PCA & Exclusion) are marked 'REJECTED' in the analyze report. These tasks are critical dependencies for FR-002 (stratified split), FR-005 (PCA reduction), and all subsequent model training tasks (T012-T016). Their failure means no tasks exist to generate the required `raw_train.csv`, `features_train_20pca.csv`, or `pca_transformer.pkl` artifacts, blocking the entire pipeline.

Task T014 (MC Dropout Inference) is marked 'REJECTED' in the analyze report. FR-004 explicitly requires implementing MC-Dropout with 30 stochastic passes. The absence of a valid task to generate `uq_predictions_mc_dropout.csv` and the model checkpoint means one of the three required UQ methods (Deep Ensembles, MC-Dropout, Sparse GP) cannot be implemented or evaluated.

Tasks T015b (Sparse GP Fitting) and T015c (Sparse GP Saving) are marked 'REJECTED' in the analyze report. FR-005 requires implementing Sparse GP regression. The failure of these tasks means the third required UQ method cannot be implemented, violating the comparative assessment requirement of the spec.

Tasks T028a through T028e (Screening Logic) are marked 'REJECTED' in the analyze report. FR-007 and US-3 require a downstream screening case study comparing UQ-based filtering against baselines. The failure of these tasks means the practical utility validation (US-3) cannot be performed.

Task T029b (McNemar's test) is marked 'REJECTED' in the analyze report. US-3 Acceptance Scenario 2 explicitly requires a statistical test (p-value < 0.05 from McNemar's test) to validate precision gain. The absence of a valid task to perform this test leaves the success criteria for US-3 untestable.

Task T001a contains a comment 'FAILED: unspecified' and is marked as 'REJECTED' in the analyze report, but the task description itself is present. However, the task status indicates it was not successfully completed or verified, creating a stale state where the task exists but the work is undone. This requires re-implementation or status correction.

Tasks T012 (Baseline NN) and T013 (Deep Ensemble) are marked 'FAILED: unspecified' in the analyze report. While the task descriptions exist, the 'FAILED' status implies the work was attempted but not completed or verified. This creates a gap where the tasks are present but the artifacts (model definitions, ensemble checkpoints) are missing, blocking downstream tasks.
